settings.miuiSetupMsg:
MIUI usually does not block sensors with a permission prompt. Instead, it kills or restricts apps in the background. Please check these settings:

1. Battery saver -> set this app to No restrictions / Unrestricted
2. Autostart -> allow this app to start automatically
3. App info -> Other permissions / Background location -> allow always
4. Recent apps screen -> lock this app so MIUI does not swipe-kill it
5. Disable any Game Turbo / extreme battery saver mode while testing

Tap Open Settings to jump to the app settings page first.

settings.fallCheckNoAccelerometer: This phone does not provide an accelerometer, so fall detection cannot run.
settings.fallCheckNoGyroscope: This phone does not provide a gyroscope. The app has switched to an accelerometer-only fallback, so shake-style tests may be less reliable.
settings.fallCheckNoBackground: Background service is not running. On MIUI, battery saver or background restrictions may be stopping fall detection even when sensors are available.
settings.fallCheckOk: Sensors look available on this phone. If the test alert opens, the emergency overlay path is working.
